findings.description: `request` now takes `max_attempts`. The `attempts=1` call in create_ticket was not renamed, so it falls into `**fields` and is sent to the API as a JSON body field `attempts`. `max_attempts` keeps its default of 3. POST /tickets is non-idempotent, so a timeout or 5xx can now be retried and create duplicate tickets. The vendor may also reject or ignore the unexpected `attempts` field.
findings.suggestion: Change `attempts=1` to `max_attempts=1` in the create_ticket call.
